summary: Use configured usage.limits.observed claims as the sole durable quota source for account displays, budgets, pool scheduling and weekly enforcement; remove harness.limits.

replay.detail: Quota projections rebuild from retained usage.limits.observed claims. Historical harness.limits claims are not converted into provider quota evidence. Newer unreported or unsupported readings replace older numeric windows.

schema.detail: The rebuildable account-limit projection uses a fresh version 4 namespace. AccountLimit exposes typed per-window percentages, measurement times, resets, coverage, source and host instead of legacy weekly/five-hour fields.

rules.detail: Rules version 27 and checkpoint staging version 2 remove obsolete harness.limits pruning. Checkpoint participants need matching updated rule digests before sealing new checkpoints. Durable observed claims remain retained.

compatibility.detail: UsageLimit wire and SDK consumers move together to typed windows; legacy weekly/five-hour fields are removed without aliases. All quota consumers select configured observation writers. Reported evidence requires a future reset and is usable for at most one hour. Missing, expired and unreported evidence remains unavailable, not unused capacity. In-memory harness RateLimits remain independent readiness signals.

downtime.detail: Deploy the external quota publisher and writer configuration before this cutover, and observe fresh usage.limits.observed claims before upgrading consumers. Without usable observations budgets are unavailable and automatic quota enforcement makes no decision.

manual.detail: Configure authorized omp-usage writer identities on quota-consuming members and restart after configuration changes. Upgrade usage clients with the windows wire contract and checkpoint participants with the matching rules.

recovery.detail: Original durable observations remain retained. Reverting the binary and corresponding clients restores the previous contract; derived quota state rebuilds from retained claims on upgrade. Restore matching checkpoint participants before sealing checkpoints after a rollback.
